module_summary: AXI-Lite write-to-Wishbone bridge that pairs AW and W beats (with skid holding registers), issues WB write strobes, and tracks requests via first/mid/last FIFO pointers to return in-order B responses with error propagation.

anchors.name: axi_write_accepted
anchors.why: Fires when AW+W pair available, FIFO not full, WB not stalled; launches WB strobe

anchors.name: i_axi_awvalid
anchors.why: AXI write-address valid captured into r_addr or forwarded

anchors.name: o_axi_awready
anchors.why: AW ready dropped on WB stall, error, FIFO full or missing write data

anchors.name: i_axi_wvalid
anchors.why: AXI write-data valid captured into r_data or forwarded

anchors.name: o_axi_wready
anchors.why: W ready dropped on WB stall, error, FIFO full or missing address

anchors.name: o_axi_bvalid
anchors.why: Write response valid raised on WB ack/err, held while responses remain

anchors.name: o_axi_bresp
anchors.why: Write response code, SLVERR for the errored transaction location

anchors.name: o_wb_stb
anchors.why: WB write strobe set on accepted AXI write, cleared when not stalled

anchors.name: o_wb_cyc
anchors.why: WB cycle active while strobe or acks pending

anchors.name: i_wb_ack
anchors.why: WB acknowledge advancing r_mid and raising bvalid

anchors.name: i_wb_stall
anchors.why: WB stall holding strobe/payload and dropping AXI readies

anchors.name: i_wb_err
anchors.why: WB error input setting err_state and err_loc

anchors.name: o_wb_addr
anchors.why: WB word address from r_addr or direct AXI awaddr

anchors.name: o_wb_data
anchors.why: WB write data from r_data or direct AXI wdata

anchors.name: o_wb_sel
anchors.why: WB byte selects from r_sel or AXI wstrb

anchors.name: i_axi_awaddr
anchors.why: AXI write address, word bits sent to WB address

anchors.name: i_axi_wdata
anchors.why: AXI write data forwarded or held for WB

anchors.name: r_awvalid
anchors.why: Held-address valid when AW arrived before it could be issued

anchors.name: r_addr
anchors.why: Holds AW address until paired write is issued

anchors.name: r_wvalid
anchors.why: Held-data valid when W arrived before it could be issued

anchors.name: r_data
anchors.why: Holds W data until paired write is issued

anchors.name: r_first
anchors.why: Count of issued WB requests (FIFO write pointer)

anchors.name: r_mid
anchors.why: Count of WB acks/errs received (middle pointer)

anchors.name: r_last
anchors.why: Count of B responses returned (FIFO read pointer)

anchors.name: fifo_full
anchors.why: Outstanding-transaction FIFO full; blocks acceptance and AXI readies

anchors.name: err_state
anchors.why: Error mode after WB err; kills strobes and drains responses with errors

anchors.name: err_loc
anchors.why: Records r_mid position of failed transaction for bresp

anchors.name: wb_outstanding
anchors.why: Counts WB requests awaiting ack

anchors.name: wb_pending
anchors.why: WB acks pending flag keeping o_wb_cyc high

anchors.name: pending_axi_write
anchors.why: Both address and data available for a write

anchors.name: fifo_empty
anchors.why: FIFO empty flag (unused, formal only)

groups.name: AXI write intake
groups.description: AW/W handshakes with holding registers pairing address and data

groups.name: WB master issue
groups.description: Issues WB write strobes and tracks outstanding acks

groups.name: Transaction tracking FIFO
groups.description: First/mid/last pointers tracking issued, acked and responded writes

groups.name: Response and error
groups.description: Generates B responses in order, marking WB-errored transactions
